title: ആധുനിക വൈദ്യവും മൃഗബലിയും The Science Brigade
description:
#thesciencebrigade #animaltrials #palebluethoughts 
This is a live recording of the discussion on the topic of animal trials in Modern Medicine which was conducted by The Science Brigade on Sat, 20th November 2021 in Clubhouse. This discussion clearly explains the history of animal testing, why animal testing is important and how it is done in the modern world and the steps taken to replace, reduce and refine the process of animal testing, how animal testing has helped us in the discovery of insulin and other critical medicines and procedures. The discussion also explains the latest development called organoids which is making strides to reduce the amount of animal testing in labs. This recording is made public after receiving permission from the speakers and TSB. This recording is in Malayalam 
Join Science Brigade on clubhouse - https://www.clubhouse.com/join/the-science-brigade
